meta.title: Village of the Black Mist
meta.tagline: You leave the road, enter a village missing from every map, and the mist no longer wants to let you go.

strings.vbn.s01.title: The Cut-Off Road
strings.vbn.s01.body: Night falls faster than expected. Below you, you see a village pressed against the mountain. It is not on any map, but the road clearly leads down to it.
strings.vbn.s01.c1: Go down toward the village entrance
strings.vbn.s01.c2: Look at the central square first
strings.vbn.s01.c3: Follow the nearest street without stopping
strings.vbn.s02.title: The Nameless Sign
strings.vbn.s02.body: At the entrance, a rusty sign is still standing. It must have carried a name once, but almost nothing remains. The mist drifts in front of it as if it were breathing.
strings.vbn.s02.c2: Head back toward the village center
strings.vbn.s02.c3: Look for a call box or a phone
strings.vbn.s03.title: The Empty Square
strings.vbn.s03.body: The square is small. A dry fountain stands in the middle. There is no human sound. Still, you have the clear feeling that something is watching you.
strings.vbn.s03.c1: Approach a house with closed shutters
strings.vbn.s03.c3: Take the darker street on the right
strings.vbn.s04.title: The Closed Houses
strings.vbn.s04.body: The shutters are closed, but not all in the same way. Some doors look old. Others seem to have been shut this very morning.
strings.vbn.s04.c2: Examine a house with a half-open window
strings.vbn.s04.c3: Look for a way to call for help
strings.vbn.s05.title: Three Streets
strings.vbn.s05.body: You reach an intersection. One street climbs toward taller houses. Another descends toward a small chapel. The last one slips between tight walls.
strings.vbn.s05.c1: Go toward the house with the half-open window
strings.vbn.s05.c3: Walk toward the chapel in the distance
strings.vbn.s06.title: Nothing Answers
strings.vbn.s06.body: You find an old call box. It is dead. Your phone has no signal either. On the screen, the time hesitates, as if it cannot move forward.
strings.vbn.s07.title: The Half-Open Window
strings.vbn.s07.body: One house catches your eye. A curtain moves even though there is no wind. The inside looks empty, but you are not sure.
strings.vbn.s07.c3: Leave this place and take the alley again
strings.vbn.s08.title: Behind the Glass
strings.vbn.s08.body: You press your eyes to the glass. The entryway is dark. Farther in, a hallway cuts the house in two. Nothing moves, but the silence feels too recent.
strings.vbn.s08.c1: Go around and look for the door
strings.vbn.s08.c3: Give up and step back into the street
strings.vbn.s09.title: The Cold Handle
strings.vbn.s09.body: You find the door. The handle is icy. As if someone has just let go of it.
strings.vbn.s10.title: The Hallway
strings.vbn.s10.body: You are inside. A hallway leads toward a living room. A table can be seen in another room. An old mirror reflects a pale light at the far end.
strings.vbn.s10.c2: Go into the room with the table
strings.vbn.s10.c3: Observe the mirror before going farther
strings.vbn.s11.title: The Frozen Living Room
strings.vbn.s11.body: The furniture is there, neatly arranged, covered in dust. Nothing was taken. You feel as if you are standing in a place that was abandoned suddenly.
strings.vbn.s11.c1: Search the room in more detail
strings.vbn.s11.c2: Look at the photo hanging on the wall
strings.vbn.s11.c3: Get out of this house quickly
strings.vbn.s12.title: The Abandoned Meal
strings.vbn.s12.body: The table is still set. The plates are dry, but it looks like everything was left there very recently. As if people vanished between two gestures.
strings.vbn.s12.c1: Look for what is hanging on the wall
strings.vbn.s12.c2: Return to the mirror in the hallway
strings.vbn.s13.title: The Photo of the Village
strings.vbn.s13.body: The photo shows this same square. The houses are the same. But the faces are too blurry. And yet, one of them looks a little like yours.
strings.vbn.s13.c2: Go outside and head to the two-story house
strings.vbn.s13.c3: Leave the house and take the street again
strings.vbn.s14.title: The Delayed Reflection
strings.vbn.s14.body: You approach the mirror. For one second, your reflection does not follow your movement exactly. Then everything becomes normal again. Almost.
strings.vbn.s14.c3: Follow the street where you think you saw a black shape
strings.vbn.s15.title: Outside Again
strings.vbn.s15.body: When you step outside, the mist is thicker than before. You can see less, but you feel as if the streets have stretched. As if the village grew longer while you were inside.
strings.vbn.s16.title: The Tight Alley
strings.vbn.s16.body: The walls are so close that they almost force you to follow one direction. You pass beneath motionless laundry. Nobody lives here, but everything is still here.
strings.vbn.s16.c2: Enter a small courtyard on the side
strings.vbn.s17.title: The Covered Passage
strings.vbn.s17.body: Under the arch, the air changes. The sound of your footsteps becomes duller. You think you hear something scraping above you.
strings.vbn.s17.c1: Go to the end of the passage
strings.vbn.s17.c3: Step out toward the street with distant silhouettes
strings.vbn.s18.title: The Silent Courtyard
strings.vbn.s18.body: The courtyard is empty. An old well has been sealed with planks. The place feels as if it was used to hide something.
strings.vbn.s18.c3: Reach the street where the mist moves
strings.vbn.s19.title: The Old Shop
strings.vbn.s19.body: The sign is almost erased. The door has swollen from the damp, but it gives a little under your hand.
strings.vbn.s19.c2: Give up and go to the two-story house
strings.vbn.s19.c3: Take the road to the chapel instead
strings.vbn.s20.title: The Counter
strings.vbn.s20.body: The inside is frozen in place. Empty shelves. An old cash register. On the counter, a ledger remains open, as if waiting to be read.
strings.vbn.s20.c2: Look at the paper stuck underneath it
strings.vbn.s20.c3: Leave the shop and aim for the inn near the center
strings.vbn.s21.title: The Crossed-Out Names
strings.vbn.s21.body: The ledger contains names, then thick black lines. The last line has no name. Just an empty space.
strings.vbn.s21.c1: Examine the paper under the ledger
strings.vbn.s21.c3: Go out and follow the chapel street
strings.vbn.s22.title: The Simple Drawing
strings.vbn.s22.body: The paper shows a small bell and an arrow. The line looks hurried. The arrow points toward the chapel, like advice given at the last second.
strings.vbn.s22.c1: Follow the arrow toward the chapel
strings.vbn.s22.c2: Ignore the paper and enter the chapel from the front
strings.vbn.s22.c3: Change your mind and go to the inn
strings.vbn.s23.title: The Chapel Street
strings.vbn.s23.body: The chapel slowly takes shape in the mist. The farther you go, the quieter the village behind you seems. Too quiet.
strings.vbn.s23.c2: Change direction and visit the two-story house
strings.vbn.s23.c3: Stop to watch what passes through the street
strings.vbn.s24.title: The Two-Story House
strings.vbn.s24.body: This house looks more intact than the others. A curtain moves on the second floor. You see no one, but someone could easily see you.
strings.vbn.s24.c2: Give up and go to the inn
strings.vbn.s24.c3: Leave and take the road to the chapel again
strings.vbn.s25.title: The Stairs
strings.vbn.s25.body: The staircase creaks under your weight. Each step seems to warn the upper floor that you are coming. The air grows colder as you climb.
strings.vbn.s25.c2: Go back down toward the black street
strings.vbn.s25.c3: Leave the house and go to the inn
strings.vbn.s26.title: The Plain Bedroom
strings.vbn.s26.body: The bedroom is almost empty. A bed. A chair. On the wall, a dark mark has been drawn at the height of a person.
strings.vbn.s26.c2: Get out of the room quickly
strings.vbn.s26.c3: Leave the house and reach the inn
strings.vbn.s27.title: The Split Circle
strings.vbn.s27.body: The sign looks like a circle open on one side, like a poorly closed door. As you look at it, you understand one thing: running is not enough. You have to find the right passage.
strings.vbn.s27.c1: Memorize the sign and go back outside
strings.vbn.s27.c2: Look for the same sign elsewhere
strings.vbn.s27.c3: Leave the place and go to the inn
strings.vbn.s28.title: Shapes in the Mist
strings.vbn.s28.body: At the end of the street, several black shapes slowly glide between the houses. They do not walk normally. They slide with the same movement.
strings.vbn.s29.title: The Chapel
strings.vbn.s29.body: The small chapel is still standing. Its wooden door is closed, but not blocked. The place is not reassuring. Still, it gives an impression of order.
strings.vbn.s29.c2: Go around through the cemetery behind it
strings.vbn.s29.c3: Turn back because something is approaching in the street
strings.vbn.s30.title: The Empty Pews
strings.vbn.s30.body: Inside, there is no one. The pews are in place. The altar is simple. A dark stained-glass window lets in a cold light.
strings.vbn.s31.title: The Small Bell
strings.vbn.s31.body: Near the altar, a small bell rests on the wood. It is not precious, but it was clearly left there for a reason.
strings.vbn.s31.c2: Take the bell, then read the stained-glass window
strings.vbn.s31.c3: Take the bell, then go through the side door
strings.vbn.s32.title: The Black Stained Glass
strings.vbn.s32.body: The stained glass shows silhouettes moving in a line, heads lowered. At the very bottom, a small white space stands apart from the rest, like an exit or a crack.
strings.vbn.s32.c1: Go see the cemetery behind it
strings.vbn.s32.c2: Return to the street where the procession passes
strings.vbn.s32.c3: Leave the chapel for the inn
strings.vbn.s33.title: The Side Door
strings.vbn.s33.body: The door opens behind the chapel. The air is damper there. You smell earth and cold stone.
strings.vbn.s33.c3: Leave this area and go to the inn
strings.vbn.s34.title: The Gravestones
strings.vbn.s34.body: The cemetery is small. Several stones lean crookedly. Some are so worn that nothing can be read anymore.
strings.vbn.s34.c2: Follow the path leading farther on
strings.vbn.s35.title: The Same Sign
strings.vbn.s35.body: On one gravestone, you find the exact split circle you saw in the bedroom. This time, the sign is carved above a pattern that looks like a spring or a basin.
strings.vbn.s35.c2: Take out the bell and look at it closely
strings.vbn.s35.c3: Look for a washhouse or basin in the village
strings.vbn.s36.title: The Bell in Your Hand
strings.vbn.s36.body: The metal is cold, but not dead. You hold it and know it will be useful for something. Not to call the living.
strings.vbn.s36.c2: Look for the washhouse mentioned by the signs
strings.vbn.s36.c3: Return to the street of the procession
strings.vbn.s37.title: The Narrow Path
strings.vbn.s37.body: A path cuts through the cemetery to an old gate. Beyond it, you can make out a trail that seems to leave the village.
strings.vbn.s37.c2: Leave this path and look for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s38.title: The Gate
strings.vbn.s38.body: The gate is not locked, but it resists as if something were holding it from the other side. Beyond it, the trail immediately disappears into white.
strings.vbn.s38.c1: Force your way through and try to leave
strings.vbn.s38.c2: Drop it and look for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s39.title: The False Departure
strings.vbn.s39.body: You move through the mist, then suddenly recognize the fountain in the square. The path has brought you back to the village without making you turn.
strings.vbn.s40.title: The Center of the Trap
strings.vbn.s40.body: The square seems darker than before. The streetlamp gives less light. You understand that leaving at random will not help.
strings.vbn.s40.c1: Finally observe the procession up close
strings.vbn.s41.title: The Black Procession
strings.vbn.s41.body: You see it clearly. Silhouettes pass slowly through the main street. They do not seem to walk. They all glide at the same rhythm.
strings.vbn.s41.c1: Follow the line from a distance
strings.vbn.s41.c2: Watch the procession from a window
strings.vbn.s41.c3: Move away and reach the inn
strings.vbn.s42.title: The Slow Line
strings.vbn.s42.body: The silhouettes never turn their heads. They pass in front of doors and walls as if the village has always belonged to them.
strings.vbn.s43.title: Behind a Window
strings.vbn.s43.body: From inside a dark house, you watch the procession pass outside. The window barely protects you. One silhouette seems to slow down as it passes in front of you.
strings.vbn.s44.title: Too Close
strings.vbn.s44.body: One of the shapes is clearer than the others. Its head lifts slightly. You cannot see its face, but you know it has sensed you.
strings.vbn.s45.title: After the Passage
strings.vbn.s45.body: The street becomes empty again. On the ground, damp marks remain on the cobblestones. They go toward the village center, then vanish.
strings.vbn.s45.c2: Follow another trail toward the washhouse
strings.vbn.s46.title: The Inn
strings.vbn.s46.body: The inn rises slightly above the square. It is the largest building in the village. If someone understood this place before you, they may have left something here.
strings.vbn.s46.c2: Leave the inn and look for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s47.title: The Hall
strings.vbn.s47.body: The hall is empty. A worn counter faces the entrance. A staircase leads upstairs. You also notice a large ledger near a dead lamp.
strings.vbn.s47.c3: Leave the inn for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s48.title: The Last Pages
strings.vbn.s48.body: The ledger records arrivals, then nothing. The last page mentions a passage beneath the village, but the text stops at the word water.
strings.vbn.s48.c1: Go upstairs to check the rooms
strings.vbn.s48.c2: Go to the attic to look for more papers
strings.vbn.s48.c3: Go out to look for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s49.title: The Upper Floor
strings.vbn.s49.body: The staircase leads to a hallway of rooms. At the end, a window looks out onto the mist. One door is half-open.
strings.vbn.s49.c3: Leave the inn and head to the washhouse
strings.vbn.s50.title: The Traveler’s Room
strings.vbn.s50.body: The room is plain. The bed is unmade. The window looks out onto a street hidden under the mist. You feel as if this room was meant for you.
strings.vbn.s50.c3: Go back down and look for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s51.title: The Black Coats
strings.vbn.s51.body: Several black coats hang in the wardrobe, all alike, all your size. The fabric is dry, but you smell the dampness from outside.
strings.vbn.s51.c1: Close it and look at the mirror
strings.vbn.s51.c3: Leave the room and head to the washhouse
strings.vbn.s52.title: The Wrong Reflection
strings.vbn.s52.body: In the mirror, you see the procession behind you. Yet the room is empty, and so is the street outside. You understand that the village already seems to have saved a place for you.
strings.vbn.s52.c2: Stay too long in front of the mirror
strings.vbn.s52.c3: Go out and head to the washhouse
strings.vbn.s53.title: The Attic
strings.vbn.s53.body: The attic smells of dry wood and dust. An old trunk rests against a wall. Someone must have searched for a way out here before you.
strings.vbn.s53.c2: Go back down and look for the washhouse
strings.vbn.s53.c3: Go straight out onto the heights if there is a way
strings.vbn.s54.title: The Trunk
strings.vbn.s54.body: Inside, you find papers, a rough map of the village, and a sheet folded several times. Some lines are heavily marked around a washhouse.
strings.vbn.s54.c2: Leave this and reach the heights
strings.vbn.s54.c3: Go out and head to the washhouse
strings.vbn.s55.title: The Map
strings.vbn.s55.body: The map shows the streets, the chapel, the inn, then a passage drawn beneath a basin. One sentence appears twice: do not leave through the mist, leave under the stone.
strings.vbn.s56.title: The Washhouse
strings.vbn.s56.body: The basin is old. The water is black and still. One slab on the side seems less fixed than the others.
strings.vbn.s56.c3: Try the exit trail through the mist again
strings.vbn.s57.title: The Shifted Slab
strings.vbn.s57.body: The slab moves. Beneath it, a narrow staircase descends under the village. The air rising from below is cold, but alive.
strings.vbn.s57.c2: Put the slab back and go to the heights
strings.vbn.s57.c3: Go back up and try the mist exit
strings.vbn.s58.title: Under the Village
strings.vbn.s58.body: The stone steps are damp. The sound from outside disappears. For the first time, you feel as if you are leaving the surface and reaching the central place.
strings.vbn.s58.c3: Go back up to try leaving through the mist
strings.vbn.s59.title: The Gallery
strings.vbn.s59.body: The gallery is narrow. The walls hold traces of water. Farther on, the passage seems to split.
strings.vbn.s59.c3: Give up and climb back toward the mist
strings.vbn.s60.title: The Empty Niches
strings.vbn.s60.body: A small room opens on the side. Niches are carved into the walls. They are empty, but not forgotten.
strings.vbn.s60.c1: Examine the drawings at the back
strings.vbn.s60.c2: Return to the passage that splits
strings.vbn.s60.c3: Leave the underground area and go back up
strings.vbn.s61.title: The Fresco
strings.vbn.s61.body: The fresco shows the village, the procession, then a white opening under the earth. One symbol appears again and again. It is the same one from the bedroom. Without that memory, you probably would not have noticed it.
strings.vbn.s61.c2: Look for the path of the symbol
strings.vbn.s61.c3: Go back up before it is too late
strings.vbn.s62.title: Two Directions
strings.vbn.s62.body: The corridor splits. One path leads toward a small, drier room. The other descends toward a sealed door.
strings.vbn.s62.c3: Turn back and leave the tunnels
strings.vbn.s63.title: The Ritual Chamber
strings.vbn.s63.body: The room is bare. A stone bench faces a circular groove in the floor. You immediately think of the bell.
strings.vbn.s63.c2: Give up and go back up toward the heights
strings.vbn.s63.c3: Give up and go back up toward the mist
strings.vbn.s64.title: The Sealed Door
strings.vbn.s64.body: The stone door has no handle and no lock. You recognize the split circle, carved almost invisibly, along with a small groove made for a brief sound or a light strike.
strings.vbn.s64.c1: Try to open it with what you have understood
strings.vbn.s64.c2: Go back up toward the heights
strings.vbn.s64.c3: Leave everything and return to the mist
strings.vbn.s65.title: The Crypt
strings.vbn.s65.body: The stone finally gives way. A crypt opens. The air inside is ancient, but clearer. You feel that you have forced your way into the heart of the village.
strings.vbn.s65.c2: Move toward a small door at the back
strings.vbn.s65.c3: Go back out with this discovery in mind
strings.vbn.s66.title: The Engraved Floor
strings.vbn.s66.body: The floor repeats the split circle again and again. The mist does not enter here. Here, something once separated the two sides.
strings.vbn.s66.c3: Leave the crypt and go back up
strings.vbn.s67.title: The Low Door
strings.vbn.s67.body: The door is too small to be noble. It was made for passing through, not for staying. A white breath slips underneath it.
strings.vbn.s67.c2: Take another tunnel that climbs back up
strings.vbn.s67.c3: Give up and reach the heights
strings.vbn.s68.title: The Deep Chamber
strings.vbn.s68.body: The rock opens into a larger chamber. At the far end, a white light cuts through the darkness like a wound in the world.
strings.vbn.s68.c2: Look for the way back up instead
strings.vbn.s69.title: The Crack
strings.vbn.s69.body: It is not a lamp. It is not fire. It is a thin, bright, unstable opening. You understand that the village was built around this opening.
strings.vbn.s69.c2: Try to fully understand this place
strings.vbn.s69.c3: Refuse the crack and go back outside
strings.vbn.s70.title: The Rising Tunnel
strings.vbn.s70.body: Another passage climbs toward open air. You have not escaped the trap yet, but you have found the direction of the slope again.
strings.vbn.s70.c2: Try to find a clearer opening to the outside
strings.vbn.s70.c3: Go back down and return to the mist
strings.vbn.s71.title: The Heights
strings.vbn.s71.body: You emerge at a high point above the village. From here, the streets seem to form a loop. As if the whole place turns around a hidden center.
strings.vbn.s71.c2: Approach the standing stone near the path
strings.vbn.s71.c3: Test the trail swallowed by the mist again
strings.vbn.s72.title: The Loop
strings.vbn.s72.body: From the heights, you see the procession always following the same route. It is not just passing through. It is keeping the village in place.
strings.vbn.s72.c2: Stay too close to the edge and draw a silhouette
strings.vbn.s73.title: The Standing Stone
strings.vbn.s73.body: Near the path, an old stone marks a precise point. Its surface bears the split circle. You also notice a perfect place to set something down or ring something.
strings.vbn.s73.c2: Ignore the stone and move into the mist
strings.vbn.s73.c3: Return to a safer threshold before the final choice
strings.vbn.s74.title: The White Wall
strings.vbn.s74.body: The trail disappears into a compact white mass. This is not simple fog. You feel it one step before even entering it.
strings.vbn.s74.c2: Return to the last calm threshold
strings.vbn.s74.c3: Use the bell if you have it
strings.vbn.s75.title: The Forced Return
strings.vbn.s75.body: You move forward, then without understanding how, you are already returning toward the village. You did not walk long. Yet you are already almost back where you started.
strings.vbn.s75.c1: Return to the threshold of decision
strings.vbn.s75.c2: Give in and walk toward the procession
strings.vbn.s75.c3: Ring the bell if you carry it
strings.vbn.s76.title: The Right Sound
strings.vbn.s76.body: When the bell rings, the mist changes. It does not pull back right away, but it reacts to the sound. The sound seems to pass through the stone, the village, and whatever hides beneath it.
strings.vbn.s76.c1: Ring again and wait for an answer
strings.vbn.s76.c2: Stop and return to the threshold
strings.vbn.s76.c3: Follow the complete path if everything finally aligns
strings.vbn.s77.title: The Reaction
strings.vbn.s77.body: The mist tightens, then opens slightly. You glimpse a gap. It will not stay clear for long.
strings.vbn.s77.c3: Return to the threshold and decide calmly
strings.vbn.s78.title: The Lone Shape
strings.vbn.s78.body: One silhouette leaves the procession. It comes toward you slowly. Not to attack. To take your place, or to show it to you.
strings.vbn.s78.c1: Back up to the final threshold
strings.vbn.s78.c2: Let it approach and stop fighting
strings.vbn.s78.c3: Try the complete path if you have understood everything
strings.vbn.s79.title: The Threshold
strings.vbn.s79.body: You stand between the village, the mist, and what you now know. You feel that one last choice will define you. Flee. Give in. Or go all the way to the truth.
strings.vbn.s79.c3: Keep searching for the whole truth
strings.vbn.s80.title: The Real Opening
strings.vbn.s80.body: Far away, a true passage has formed. You see the mountain road beyond it. For the first time, the outside looks more real than the village.
strings.vbn.s80.c3: Linger and look for something else
strings.vbn.s81.title: Everything Answers
strings.vbn.s81.body: The sign, the bell, and the crypt finally answer one another. What you saw separately becomes one single path. The village is not a dead place. It is a crossing point between two worlds.
strings.vbn.s81.c1: Follow this understanding to the end
strings.vbn.s81.c2: Refuse at the last moment and give in to the procession
strings.vbn.s82.title: The True Village
strings.vbn.s82.body: You see the village as it truly is. A living border. The procession is not there to wander. It maintains the balance. Those who enter by mistake must be sent back, replaced, or kept.
strings.vbn.s82.c1: Accept the truth and take the right way out
strings.vbn.s82.c2: Reject this truth and simply try to flee
strings.vbn.s82.c3: Return one last time to the final choice
strings.vbn.s83.title: Almost Inside
strings.vbn.s83.body: You feel the rhythm of the procession entering your body. Your steps want to match theirs. Very little of you remains.
strings.vbn.s84.title: The Last Crossroads
strings.vbn.s84.body: Everything returns here. The open road, the black line, the underground truth. The village lets you choose, but only one direction will leave you whole.
strings.vbn.s84.c3: Follow the complete path if it still exists
strings.vbn.end_good.title: ENDING — You Get Out
strings.vbn.end_good.body: You cross the opening without looking behind you. When dawn returns, you find the mountain road and your car. When you turn around, there is no village anymore. Only the slope, the stone, and a fog that fades too quickly.
strings.vbn.end_bad.title: ENDING — The Black Line
strings.vbn.end_bad.body: You stop fighting. The slow rhythm enters your legs, then your breath. When the procession passes through the main street again, there is one more silhouette. It moves forward without a face, but it is still your size.
strings.vbn.end_secret.title: SECRET ENDING — The Seam
strings.vbn.end_secret.body: You understand the village’s role and the mistake that brought you there. The bell does not open a simple exit. It puts each side back in its place. The crack tightens, the procession slows, then lets you go. You leave alive, but with the certainty that other places like this exist between worlds.
strings.vbn.h.s22.soft: The drawing is not trying to look pretty. It shows a useful direction.
strings.vbn.h.s22.strong: The chapel contains an important object. Go toward it without wandering too much.
strings.vbn.h.s27.soft: The black sign is not just there to scare you. It will come back later.
strings.vbn.h.s27.strong: Memorize the split circle. It helps you understand the right path under the village.
strings.vbn.h.s31.soft: An object placed alone near the altar is never there by chance.
strings.vbn.h.s31.strong: Take the bell. It helps you progress and opens another path.
strings.vbn.h.s35.soft: When the same sign appears again, it is not just a detail.
strings.vbn.h.s35.strong: The sign on the gravestone points to the washhouse or to a passage under the village.
strings.vbn.h.s55.soft: The map clearly tells you not to rely on the mist to leave.
strings.vbn.h.s55.strong: Go to the washhouse. The real passage is under the stone, not in the white trail.
strings.vbn.h.s61.soft: The fresco only becomes clear if you connect the things you have already seen.
strings.vbn.h.s61.strong: If you saw the black sign, look for a path linked to that symbol in the tunnels.
strings.vbn.h.s63.soft: The room seems to be waiting for a simple gesture, not brute force.
strings.vbn.h.s63.strong: The bell is useful here. Without it, you may end up circling around or going back up too soon.
strings.vbn.h.s64.soft: The door does not open at random. It requires real understanding.
strings.vbn.h.s64.strong: To open the crypt, you need to have seen the black sign and have the bell.
strings.vbn.h.s69.soft: The crack can let you out, but it can also explain everything.
strings.vbn.h.s69.strong: A good ending is possible here. The secret ending only works if you have the three flags.
strings.vbn.h.s73.soft: The standing stone looks like a point of contact, not decoration.
strings.vbn.h.s73.strong: Use the bell here if you have it. This is a strong step toward the exit.
strings.vbn.h.s76.soft: The first sound may not be enough. Sometimes you have to insist or align everything.
strings.vbn.h.s76.strong: If you have seen the sign, taken the bell, and opened the crypt, the complete path can open from here.
strings.vbn.h.s79.soft: At the end, everything depends on what you understood, not only on your courage.
strings.vbn.h.s79.strong: Simple exit for the good ending. Procession for the bad ending. Whole truth for the secret ending if the three flags are there.
